name: ai-dev-kit
description: Portable agentic-development skill library: lifecycle skills, a per-project adapter contract, and a cross-platform installer.

hooks.config: hooks/installer-hooks.json (installer form, ships to consumers as hooks.json) · hooks/hooks.json (plugin form, auto-discovered by the plugin loader; smoke-enforced parity)
hooks.policy: advise, never block — hooks inject context; the agent decides

handlers.fires: package.json edits; pm add/update/upgrade or install-with-args commands
edits to AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md at any depth, files under the adapter docs.contextDir (default docs/context), or agent-memory files (~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/*.md)
a session resuming from context compaction — one-shot reorientation nudge (status doc + current row + re-verify assumed findings)

reviewed.PreCompact: rejected 0.16.0 — the event cannot inject additionalContext per the current hooks contract (verified at build); the accepted mechanism is SessionStart(compact)
reviewed.SessionStart(startup|resume|clear): rejected 0.16.0 — a per-session nudge is latency and noise; orientation on normal starts is the resume-prompt's job. Only the compact matcher is wired: compaction is the one entry where disorientation is the default

skills.name: checkpoint
skills.summary: Commit + push pending work, judge context health (three strikes on a repeated obstacle = unhealthy), then continue or hand off via an on-disk resume prompt plus a relaunch model × effort recommendation.

automation.reviewed: Step 2: deliberately not hook-automated — standing agreement + skill triggers cover the cadence; a Stop-hook nag would be noise

skills.name: doc-audit
skills.summary: Keep docs, agent context, persistent memory, and showcase docs accurate and token-lean; archive instead of delete; enforce standing-instruction budgets and cache-stable placement (hunt 7).

skills.name: project-audit
skills.summary: Score every feature group /100 against a best-available bar; verify docs ↔ code; emit a prioritized backlog.
triggers: what's missing to make this perfect

skills.name: tidy
skills.summary: Prune the unbounded local build/engine cache; surface (never auto-run) orphaned dev processes, stale test data, dangling container images — per-stack recipes in references/.

automation.existing: cache prune at checkpoint + pre-push backstop
automation.reviewed: Step 2: no Claude hook — the existing cadence already covers it

skills.name: dep-check
skills.summary: Registry-verify a dependency before adding/upgrading: real version, tags, release-age window, pin policy, peers, standing holds — per-ecosystem registry recipes in references/.

automation.active: PostToolUse (Edit|Write|Bash) → hooks/dep-check-nudge.mjs — injects the dep-check reminder on package.json edits / pm installs

skills.name: live-verify
skills.summary: Full gate, then a fresh production-shaped run (served build · game export · CLI binary · packed library · sample pipeline slice), then drive the affected flow and observe real output — per-domain mechanics in references/.

composition.defersTo: project verify/run skill (harness built-ins bootstrap one)

automation.active: PreToolUse (Bash, if git *) → hooks/live-verify-reminder.mjs — injects the live-verify reminder before commits

skills.name: project-init
skills.summary: One-time inception: plan docs or a raw idea → discovery (gaps, value-adds, competitive scan, foundation fit-map) → one batched question round → product brief + regenerated status/backlog to a 100 bar → sign-off → the pipeline begins.
triggers: here's my idea for an app
turn these plan docs into a build plan

composition.precedes: the whole pipeline — the one-time entry point for a new project
composition.scoredBy: project-audit (against the brief's feature groups + bar)

automation.reviewed: 0.4.0: no hook — a post-scaffold nudge belongs in the template's getting-started text, not machinery; the skill triggers cover invocation

skills.name: project-adopt
skills.summary: One-time brownfield inception: an existing codebase → product survey doubling as the parity contract (incoming agentic layer included) → theirs-vs-foundation disposition map under a two-tiered meaningful-improvement bar (product surface defaults keep-theirs; foundation tier defaults the target's) → data/user reality check → one batched question round → product brief + migration map with recorded comparisons + regenerated status/backlog whose completion is a surface-identical app on the target foundation, parity proven by test suites at the adopting repo's thresholds → sign-off → the pipeline begins.
triggers: port my app onto the template
migrate an existing app to this boilerplate
merge the boilerplate into my app
upgrade my app with the template's features

composition.consumes: the existing codebase — arg path/git URL or the adapter init.sourceDir drop dir; a read-only, never-committed reference
feeds: upstream candidates (template issues/PRs; keep-theirs rows double as template lessons)
composition.precedes: the whole pipeline — the one-time entry point for an existing product; the parity check becomes the standing live-verify mode for port rows
composition.scoredBy: project-audit (against the brief's feature groups + bar)

automation.reviewed: 0.6.0: no hook — same rationale as project-init; the template's getting-started text and the skill triggers cover invocation

skills.name: harness-audit
skills.summary: Periodic currency audit of the agent harness itself: inventory the local surface (skills/hooks/context files/tool servers/permissions/packaging), re-fetch the pinned authoritative specs (self-repairing references/sources.md), sweep the ecosystem with current-dated category queries (maintaining references/stack.md), diff against the rubric, and emit a dated scored report + proposed backlog rows. Report-only; sign-off gates implementation.
triggers: is our agent setup still current

composition.siblingOf: project-audit (product) · doc-audit (docs) — this one audits the agentic layer
composition.consumes: the skill linter's and eval runner's mechanical results where present (eval presence is scored from the graded pass, not fixture existence); prior HARNESS_AUDIT reports (diff-bounded)

automation.reviewed: 0.16.0: no hook, no scheduler — a calendar nudge would fire without regard to program state; the status doc's periodic-pass line and the skill triggers cover cadence

skills.name: retro
skills.summary: Post-milestone compounding harvest: corrections, surprises, re-derivations, and repeated manual steps routed to the cheapest durable home (memory · instruction line · adapter field · skill edit · hook candidate · test), each behind the normal sign-off gate; rejections recorded so lessons aren't re-litigated.
triggers: what should we learn from this
make sure this doesn't happen again

automation.reviewed: 0.16.0: no Stop/session-end hook — a retro nag after every session would be noise; checkpoint's three-strikes suggestion plus the skill triggers cover it
